request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Recolour only his skin, much lighter: arms, hands, shoulders, legs, feet and head become light sage green, colour #739a59, with lighter #9dbf80 on top and darker #4c6c3c only as thin shading; his whole face, chest and big round belly become pale cream-green, colour #cde0b4. No dark green skin. The orange paint splashes become hazard yellow, colour #fdd20f. Keep the face, tusks, stone club, straps, belt, loincloth, pose, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, transparent background.
